name: ravin-lookup
description: Ravin Lookup — offline vehicle diagnostic lookup tool
author: Netgene

scripts.pack:win:car: node scripts/set-lock.js "Car/Truck" && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.productName="Ravin Lookup Car Truck" --config.appId=com.netgene.ravin.car
scripts.pack:win:moto: node scripts/set-lock.js "Dirt Bike/Moto" && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.productName="Ravin Lookup Dirt Bike" --config.appId=com.netgene.ravin.moto
scripts.pack:win:atv: node scripts/set-lock.js "ATV/4-Wheeler" && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.productName="Ravin Lookup ATV" --config.appId=com.netgene.ravin.atv
scripts.pack:win:car:full: node scripts/set-lock.js "Car/Truck" && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis portable msi --x64 --config.productName="Ravin Lookup Car Truck" --config.appId=com.netgene.ravin.car
scripts.pack:win:moto:full: node scripts/set-lock.js "Dirt Bike/Moto" && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis portable msi --x64 --config.productName="Ravin Lookup Dirt Bike" --config.appId=com.netgene.ravin.moto
scripts.pack:win:atv:full: node scripts/set-lock.js "ATV/4-Wheeler" && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis portable msi --x64 --config.productName="Ravin Lookup ATV" --config.appId=com.netgene.ravin.atv
scripts.pack:win:all: npm run pack:win:car && npm run pack:win:moto && npm run pack:win:atv
scripts.pack:win:full: npm run pack:win:car:full && npm run pack:win:moto:full && npm run pack:win:atv:full
